answers.answer_text: For running shoes for plantar fasciitis in Hong Kong, my top pick is the HOKA Bondi 8, which offers firm heel cushioning and arch support. Another good option is the Brooks Adrenaline GTS 24. ASICS is also popular with local runners. I would avoid the Altra Escalante 4 because it has a zero-drop, low-cushion design.
